patients.summary: Healthy high school science teacher who joined in 2021. New hypertension in December 2024 led to a renal CTA showing multifocal fibromuscular dysplasia with renal artery stenosis and renovascular hypertension; the right ICA is also involved. Amlodipine from September 2025, cardiology angioplasty of the right renal artery in July 2026 after last seen.

documents.title: New patient call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller is a 30 y/o woman, teaches high school science, moving her care to us from a practice she used through grad school and after. No current health concerns, wants a baseline physical before school starts. BCBS card info taken. Booked new pt preventive 8/10 at 9:00. Records release form emailed to her; she will sign and send back. Membership info sent.

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
NEW PATIENT - PREVENTIVE

30 y/o woman establishing care. Teaches chemistry and earth science at a public high school. Feels well. Here mainly to have a doctor of record and get the usual screening done.

PMH: none. No hospitalizations.
PSH: none.
Meds: none. No supplements.
Allergies: no known drug allergies.
FHx: Mom has high blood pressure, diagnosed young (around 32). Dad had an ischemic stroke at 48, recovered. A paternal uncle has narrowing of a kidney artery - she does not know details.
SHx: Never smoker, no alcohol, no drugs. Runs or bikes most days. Lives on her own. Seat belt always.
Gyn: regular cycles. Last Pap 2019 at prior office, normal per pt; records requested.
Vaccines: Tdap 2017; Pfizer x2 this spring through the school district clinic.

ROS: negative in full - no headaches, no chest pain, no palpitations, no GI or GU complaints, mood good.

Exam: vitals as charted, BP normal. Well appearing. HEENT clear, TM normal, thyroid not enlarged. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender, no masses, no bruit. Skin without notable lesions. Extremities warm, pulses full. Neuro grossly normal.
PHQ-2: 0.

Assessment/Plan:
Healthy adult, preventive care.
- Baseline CBC, CMP, lipids. One-time HIV and hep C screens discussed and drawn.
- Pap due next year (3 yr from 2019); will do co-testing at next physical.
- Flu shot and COVID booster this fall when available.
- Annual visits. Message anytime.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Angela, all of your labs from Tuesday came back normal - blood counts, kidney and liver tests, cholesterol, and the HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to do. Nice to meet you, and good luck with the start of classes.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
Received from prior primary care office (records 2016-2021), 22 pages, scanned to chart.

Summary for PCP review:
- Visits mostly yearly physicals; no chronic problems listed.
- Pap smear 2019-04: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.
- Tdap 2017-06.
- Medication list: none. Allergies: NKDA.
- BP readings across visits all in normal range.

PCP reviewed 8/25. Nothing new. Pap due 2022.

documents.title: Vaccine visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body:
After-school appt. Eligible for booster as a teacher (occupational exposure). Screening questions negative, no prior reactions besides a sore arm.
Flu quadrivalent 0.5 mL IM left deltoid. Pfizer booster 0.3 mL IM right deltoid. Lots and VIS documented.
Observed 15 min, no issues. Pt left feeling fine.

reports.text: Specimen: cervical, liquid-based. Adequacy: satisfactory for evaluation; transformation zone component present. Interpretation: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. High-risk HPV: not detected.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL PREVENTIVE VISIT

31 y/o here for yearly physical, last week of summer before teachers report. No concerns. Still running most days. No meds. NKDA.

Interval: nothing new. No new family history. Never smoker, no alcohol.

ROS negative.

Exam: BP and HR as charted, normal. Weight stable. Pleasant, well. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, no tenderness, no masses. Pelvic: normal external genitalia, cervix without lesions, Pap with HPV co-test collected. Extremities without edema. Skin fine.
PHQ-2 0.

A/P: Well woman.
- Pap/HPV co-test sent.
- No labs needed this year; baseline was normal.
- Flu and the new bivalent COVID shot in October.
- Return one year.

documents.title: Pap and HPV result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Your Pap came back normal and the HPV test was negative. With both normal, the next one isn't due for five years (2027). See you next summer.

documents.title: Vaccine visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Influenza quadrivalent IM L deltoid, Pfizer bivalent booster IM R deltoid. No contraindications on screening. VIS given. Tolerated well, waited 15 min. Records updated; pt asked for a printout for her school nurse - given.

documents.title: Form for school trip
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi - I'm chaperoning a science club trip in April and the district wants a health form signed with my vaccine dates. Can I drop it off at the front desk? Thanks, Angela

documents.title: RE: Form for school trip
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Yes, drop it off anytime and we'll have it signed and ready within 2 business days. We'll message you when it's done.

documents.title: Form completed
documents.author: MA
documents.body: District chaperone health form filled out with immunization dates from chart, signed by PCP. Copy scanned. Pt notified via portal, picked up at front desk.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam. 32 y/o, healthy. Busy summer teaching a summer enrichment program. Exercising regularly. No meds, NKDA.

No new symptoms. Sleeping fine. Mood good.

Exam: vitals charted, BP normal range. Well. HEENT normal. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abd soft, nontender, no bruit. Ext no edema, pulses 2+.
PHQ-2 0.

A/P:
1. Health maintenance - CBC and CMP today since it's been two years. Pap next due 2027. Flu and COVID this fall.
2. Discussed FHx of early hypertension in mom; pressures have been normal here. Keep up exercise, keep salt moderate.
RTC 1 yr.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs all look good - normal blood count, kidney function, liver tests and electrolytes. Have a good start to the year.

documents.title: Vaccine visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: 2023-24 flu (quadrivalent) L arm, updated Pfizer COVID R arm. Screening negative. No issues after observation period.
